output:
To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us. It has gone up again, nearly £350 on last year. There is nothing I can do about it, the park sets it.

Please can you pay me by 31 January into the same account as before, as the park wants it all by then. If anybody would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. That goes for everybody, just let me know.

Nobody has asked for the same week this year so everybody gets what they asked for. Carol has Easter week and a week in September. Carol, you said any week, so tell me which one and I will put it down. Pete and Linda have May half term, 29 May to 5 June. Me and Bev have 5 to 12 June, so we will hand over with Pete and Linda on Saturday the 5th. Jan has 7 to 14 August.

Pete mentioned the shower tray was cracked. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. The parts were £140 but I am not putting that on the bill, it is done.

Two other things. Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave, the park has moaned about it again. Also the park newsletter says caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 year old so that means us. I do not know any more than that yet but I did not want it to be a surprise next year.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
